subject: UK DPA addendum & subprocessor update — sign-off and execution plan
messages:
From: Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@acumenhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Legal Ops (Acumen Health) <legal@acumenhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request to execute UK addendum + updated subprocessor list

Hi Rishi,

Per our recent discussions with procurement and our UK security team, Acumen needs a short supplemental addendum to the existing DPA to explicitly cover transfers into the UK and the updated subprocessor roster for the services we'll be using (search indexing, analytics ingestion). The contract we signed earlier referenced EU transfers only; our InfoSec requires the UK-specific language and an updated exhibit enumerating subprocessors and the controls they attest to.

Two asks from our side:
- Please provide a redline of the proposed UK addendum and updated subprocessor exhibit for our counsel to review.
- We need a clear signature plan (DocuSign preferred) — Acumen will require countersignature by our GC and the purchasing lead.

Can you confirm timelines? We are targeting completion before the UK production roll-out (mid-September).

Thanks,
Daniel Ortiz
Head of Procurement, Acumen Health

Attachment: Acumen_UK_Addendum_Request_20260801.pdf (PDF, 84KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@acumenhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-01T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request to execute UK addendum + updated subprocessor list

Daniel — thanks for the note and context. We can put a short UK-focused addendum together and include an updated subprocessor exhibit. Initial plan:

1) Redwood Legal will produce a redline of the addendum + exhibit by EOD Aug 2.
2) Commercial (Marcus) to confirm whether any concessions are needed on the updated subprocessor obligations; otherwise we proceed with our standard language and execution flow.
3) We'll send a DocuSign envelope with a two-step signing order: (1) Acumen GC/purchasing, (2) Redwood authorized signatory.

Cc'ing Laura for legal redlines and Marissa for the DocuSign/ops route.

I'll attach our draft redline shortly.

Best,
Rishi
Director, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_UK_Addendum_Redline_v1.pdf (PDF, 112KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-02T10:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Request to execute UK addendum + updated subprocessor list

Folks — attaching my redline and comments. Key points I changed and why:

- Added explicit UK data transfer paragraph that mirrors our EU transfer language but references UK adequacy and the UK Addendum to the SCCs. We should avoid wholesale SCC recitals — keep it scoped to transfers and technical measures.
- Limited the subprocessor obligations to the service categories Acumen requested (search index, analytics ingestion) and added a 60-day notice period for additions. Acumen asked for a shorter notice but our Operations team needs time to validate controls.
- Added a carve-out for security/forensic subprocessors where timely substitution isn't feasible; require post-event notice.
- Included a requirement to map encryption key ownership for UK-resident processing (KMS integration) — operations needs to confirm whether this affects the onboarding timeline.

If Sales is comfortable with the 60-day add/subprocessor notice and the KMS mapping ask, I'm fine sending this to Acumen as our formal redline. If Marcus wants to soften anything for commercial reasons, let me know.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Laura_Redline_Notes_UK_Addendum.docx (DOCX, 28KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-02T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: RE: Request to execute UK addendum + updated subprocessor list

Thanks Laura — the redline looks fine overall. A couple of commercial asks from the Acct side before we finalize:

- Can we allow a 6-month grandfathering window for existing subprocessors Acumen currently uses (this prevents a service interruption while they validate controls)?
- Limit the KMS mapping requirement to encrypted-at-rest services and avoid requiring key rotation custody changes; that would be a heavy lift for the onboarding timetable.

If Legal can accept both items as small edits, I'm comfortable proceeding to execution. We should also include a short note in the DocuSign message that this addendum does not change billing or SLAs.

Marcus Lin
Senior Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@acumenhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-03T09:17:00Z
Subject: Proposed redline and execution plan (DocuSign) — UK addendum

Daniel — attached is our consolidated redline (Laura's comments incorporated plus the sales concessions: 6-month grandfathering for existing subprocessors and limiting the KMS mapping scope to encrypted-at-rest services).

Execution plan:
- We'll upload the final addendum and updated subprocessor exhibit to DocuSign. Envelope settings: 2 signature groups (Acumen signers first — GC then purchasing; Redwood signatory last).
- Signing note (text to include in envelope): "This addendum is a limited scope supplement to the DPA executed between Acumen Health and Redwood Inference dated 2025-11-12. It pertains only to UK transfers and listed subprocessors."
- Expected timing: once you confirm the redline, we'll send the envelope the same day; typical turnaround is 1–3 business days for Acumen signatures.

Link (preview): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/654321

Please confirm that the redline is acceptable and who will be the Acumen signers (name & title).

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Rishi — thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed your consolidated redline and the concessions look fine. Signers for Acumen will be: Emily Carter, General Counsel, and Tom Hargreaves, Head of Purchasing.

I've completed the DocuSign process on behalf of Acumen — envelope completed and countersigned by Emily and Tom this afternoon. See attached final executed addendum and envelope id.

Next steps on our side: our InfoSec team will validate subprocessors during onboarding (we expect this to complete within 30 days); I'll flag anything serious and loop legal if needed.

Thanks again — please confirm once Redwood signature is applied.

Kate Summers

Acumen Health
